mentions.name: Hedgy
mentions.description: A career-matching service that helps people find startup jobs without the application process, passively pinging users with interesting interview opportunities it thinks they could take, aspiring to be 'Wealthfront for your career'. It scales reliable human-in-the-loop AI recruiter agents with very few humans to recognize great matches between people and companies/teams/missions.
mentions.problem: Everyone wants to do their life's work, but it's hard to find the right situation, company, mission, and team where they can be a force multiplier.
mentions.audience: People looking for their next startup job, reached through a friends-of-friends network
mentions.source_excerpt: Helping friends (and friends of friends of friends of friends) find their next startup gig without the application process. Aspiring to be Wealthfront for your career… a passive optimization that pings you every now and then with an interesting interview you could take.

evidence.value: Helping friends (and friends of friends of friends of friends) find their next startup gig without the application process. Aspiring to be Wealthfront for your career… a passive optimization that pings you every now and then with an interesting interview you could take.

mentions.name: Hedgy
mentions.description: A personal recruiter / talent agent service that helps developers, product people, and designers find meaningful, fun work that feels like their life's work. It focuses on referrals rather than cold applications, sidesteps the AI-spam-saturated application pipeline, and helps talented people who dislike career politicking periodically test the market through recruiter conversations so their compensation doesn't stagnate.
mentions.problem: Few people feel like they're doing meaningful 'life's work'; AI spam is killing the cold application pipeline so referrals are now essential; and the most talented builders often avoid career optimization, causing their compensation to stagnate if they never test the market.
mentions.audience: Dev/product/design friends of the author and their networks
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on a personal recruiter / talent agent for my smartest dev/product/design friends (and theirs) https://www.hedgy.works
